title: Initial D
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High-schooler Takumi Fujiwara has spent years making early-morning tofu deliveries for his father Bunta on the roads of Mount Akina in Gunma, unknowingly becoming a superb driver. When rival street-racing teams challenge the locals, Takumi in the family's old Toyota AE86 beats one rival after another. Across 48 volumes he joins Project D, an expeditionary racing team, and grows from an indifferent kid into a driver with ambition.
life_message: Mastery comes from patient daily practice, and finding the thing you truly care about gives life direction.
